digest_over: Every regular file under `bundle`, in ascending order of its bundle-relative POSIX path compared as UTF-8 bytes, as the lines `<sha256 hex of the file's bytes>  <path>\n`, themselves hashed with sha256. The sort is explicit so the answer does not depend on the order a filesystem walk returns; the path is in the digest beside the content so a rename moves it; the hex digest is fixed-width and the separator is literal, so a rename and an edit cannot cancel. Reproducible without this repository's code: `cd <bundle> && find . -type f | sed 's|^\./||' | LC_ALL=C sort | tr '\n' '\0' | xargs -0 sha256sum | sha256sum`.
build_checkout: The upstream checkout is SPARSE and that is part of the input, not an accident of the box: `git sparse-checkout list` reads `.changeset`, `scripts`, `static/schemas/source`. `manifest.json` is built by reading `static/compliance/source/specialisms/*/`, so a checkout that HAS that directory emits a `specialisms` array on 32 tools and one that does not emits none. Measured both ways at this commit: with it, `manifest.json` differs from this bundle in the specialisms blocks; without it, `manifest.json` differs in `generated_at` alone.
vendor_transform: A byte copy. Unlike `schemas/cache/3.2`, nothing is re-serialised: every `$id` the build stamps is present (1,140 of 1,141 documents carry one; `manifest.json` is the one that does not), 361 of 1,141 hold bytes outside ASCII, and 1,138 of 1,141 end in a newline. `bundled/` (124 documents) and `mcp/` (494) are excluded, which is why this bundle holds 1,141 where the artifact holds 1,759 -- and `codegen.bundle.PROJECTIONS` names those same two prefixes, so they are outside the portable population either way.

exceptions.reason: `lastUpdated` is the build's wall-clock DATE (2026-11-05 here, 2026-11-06 on re-run). Every other byte equal.
`lastUpdated` is the build's wall-clock DATE. Every other byte equal.
`_generatedAt` is a wall-clock timestamp (2026-11-05T21:32:41.103Z here). Every other byte equal.

`generated_at` is a wall-clock timestamp, equal to the one in `extensions/index.json` -- the two are written in one pass. With the sparse cone `build_checkout` names, that field is the ONLY difference; with `static/compliance/` also checked out, the specialisms blocks differ as well.
